project: Wuxia Life P50 Sample Lines Validation Implementation
description: Implement P47 config backbone, P48 player-facing expression, and P49 replay/playtest harness to close the three 0-40 minimum playable life sample lines with simulation and human evidence.

userStories.title: Implement minimum P47 config backbone for three sample lines
userStories.description: As an implementer, I want the minimum P47 spine nodes and flags wired in JSON so benchmark seeds replay without spine breaks.
acceptanceCriteria: Task O/D/M minimum nodes present per P47 PRD sections 13-15
Benchmark seeds 301/303/804 reach age 40 without critical spine gaps
route_merchant or documented interim merchant signals for seed 804
Age-40 summary hooks configured or documented interim fallback per P49 section 18.4
userStories.notes: Upstream config backbone; blocks replay pass.

userStories.title: Implement P48 orthodox and demonic player-facing expression
userStories.description: As a player, I want orthodox and demonic sample lines to show readable current goals, costs, and age-40 identity.
acceptanceCriteria: O-E1/O-E2/O-E3 implemented in existing summary or life-memory surfaces
D-E1/D-E2/D-E3 implemented in existing surfaces
No raw eventId or flag keys in player-visible checkpoint output for orthodox/demonic
Surface changes covered by at least one focused test or gate slice

userStories.title: Implement P48 merchant player-facing expression
userStories.description: As a player, I want the merchant line to show readable business goals, debt costs, and age-40 identity.
acceptanceCriteria: M-E1/M-E2/M-E3 implemented in existing surfaces
Merchant key choices wired into life-memory key-choice surface
route_merchant in long-term impact whitelist if flag writes exist
Merchant checkpoint output distinguishable from orthodox/demonic at age 25+
userStories.notes: P48 M expression tasks; merchant was weakest in P48 audit.

userStories.title: Build P49 fixed-seed replay matrix and checkpoint export
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want encoded benchmark parameters and deterministic checkpoint export for repeatable validation.
acceptanceCriteria: P49_SAMPLE_LINE_MATRIX with seeds 301/303/804 and checkpoint ages 13/18/25/32/40
0-40 simulation export includes eventId summary, route flags, life-memory entry per checkpoint
Two consecutive runs on same seed produce identical checkpoint JSON
Unit test asserts matrix length equals 3 and seed values match P49 PRD

userStories.title: Generate cross-line replay latest reports
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want cross-line delta reports so five comparison dimensions are judged at checkpoints.
acceptanceCriteria: docs/test-reports/p49-sample-lines-replay-latest.json generated
docs/test-reports/p49-sample-lines-replay-latest.md human-readable per line and checkpoint
docs/test-reports/p49-sample-lines-cross-line-comparison-latest.md with distinct/partial/collapsed
scripts/runP49SampleLineReplay.ts and npm run p49:replay regenerate reports

userStories.title: Execute human playtest round and archive results
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want at least one completed playtest round archived for human evidence.
acceptanceCriteria: At least one tester completes checklist for all three lines using seeds 301/303/804
Results saved as docs/test-reports/p49-sample-lines-playtest-round-1.md
P46 section 10.2 five items recorded with pass/warning/fail per line
Cross-line retell section shows lines distinguishable within 30 seconds
userStories.notes: P49 HR-3 execution; requires runnable build.

userStories.title: Produce P49 closure report and P46 overall verdict
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want a closure page combining simulation and human evidence for baseline readiness.
acceptanceCriteria: docs/test-reports/p49-sample-lines-closure-report.md references replay latest and playtest round
Verdict Pass/Warning/Fail per P49 validation contract section 3
Blocking failures explicitly listed if any
P46 section 11.3 overall closure status stated with residual warnings if applicable
userStories.notes: P49 HR-4; final P46 sample-line closure gate.
